High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
This is second application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.810/2022 registered at Police Station-Prithvipur, District Niwadi (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 363, 366 Ka, 376, 376(3),
376(2)(n) of IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act.
First application filed by applicant was dismissed as withdrawn.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is in jail since 01.03.2023.
Investigation in the case is complete and charge-sheet has already been filed.
Considering the fact that applicant had not kidnapped the prosecutrix, but accidentally met her in Delhi and thereafter they are married and living together.
Prosecutrix has already been examined in Court and she is hostile.

In these circumstances, applicant be enlarged on bail.

sentences.text: 3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State opposed the application.
It is submitted that prosecutrix is minor aged about 14 years and 5 months.
In these circumstance, application be dismissed.

4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5.
Prosecutrix has already been examined in Court and she is hostile.
6. Considering aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

It is directed that applicant be released on bail on furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/-(Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court.

7. The applicant shall also abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437 (3) of Cr. P. C. C.C.
as per rules.
